capabilities: Log workout sets by exercise with search and tags
Review exercise history and estimated 1RM charts
Export training data to CSV and JSON
Import workouts from FitNotes or another tracker
disambiguation: Not a general daily journaling plugin; it records workout sets, training plans and exercise history.
extras: Early preview with live desktop and mobile testing still pending; the standalone app runs from a local Node server, and the 1RM chart uses a bundled WebAssembly renderer.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log individual workout sets, track per-exercise history, or follow a dated training plan.

relations.evidence: Use the command-line JSON importer to bring in workouts from FitNotes or another tracker.
For Garmin runs and MTB rides, select Settings → Rep Journal → Garmin agent integration → Enable or repair on desktop.

summary: Workout journal that logs sets by exercise, follows dated Markdown training plans, charts estimated 1RM history, and exports training data.
